description: System prompt writer + linter — Write a production system prompt for an LLM assistant or agent from a one-line task, then lint it offline: score 0-100 with grade, checks for a role, goal, rules, output format and what to do when unsure, coverage of every tool and rule you supplied, vague wording, always/never conflicts, ALL-CAPS shouting and token length. Verdict READY or REVIEW with the issue list. Optional: role=, audience=, tone=, format=, tools= (comma list), rules= (semicolon list), length=short|medium|long. Nothing stored. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

task.description: e.g. Answer customer billing questions for a SaaS company and look up invoices
